scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @sofiya/api" "npm run dev -w @sofiya/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @sofiya/api -w @sofiya/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.lint: npm run build:shared && npm run lint --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint --workspaces && npm run test --workspaces && npm run build -w @sofiya/api -w @sofiya/web
